name: Project Maya
cost: Free (MIT). You need your own GPU hardware
works_with: Linux with NVIDIA GPUs. Windows and AMD are experimental. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API
short: Runs GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash privately on your own GPUs, with a chat page and an API for coding agents.
what: Project Maya runs two very large open models on hardware you already own. It keeps the most-used experts on the GPU, the next ones in RAM and the rest on your SSD, and tunes itself to your machine. It serves a browser chat, a live monitor, and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs with tool calls.
who: People with a strong NVIDIA GPU (or several), plenty of RAM and a big NVMe SSD who want a private, local model for chat or coding agents. Skip it on a laptop without a big GPU or if you lack hundreds of GB of free disk.
needs: An NVIDIA GPU with compute capability 7.0 or newer (V100, RTX 20 and newer), up to 16. AMD is experimental
32 GB of RAM at minimum. More is faster
A fast NVMe SSD with room for the model: about 100 GB for Maya-S, 160 GB for Maya-L, 350 GB for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017's Maya-S
Linux x86-64, the NVIDIA driver, CUDA 12.x, g++ and Python 3.10+. Not WSL2

steps.title: Clone and run the setup
steps.text: Answer a few questions (Enter takes the recommended choice). It shows each download first, builds everything once in 20 to 40 minutes plus the download, then starts the model. On Windows, run `START-MAYA.bat` instead.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.text: Go to `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Ctrl+C stops it, and `./setup.sh` starts it again.

steps.title: Point a coding agent at it
steps.text: The OpenAI-compatible API is at `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1` and the Anthropic one at `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/messages`. For Claude Code:

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `./maya.sh --bench` to measure your speed, then `--report` to share it in a GitHub issue.

watch: The engine pins most of your free RAM (all but about 6 GB) while it runs, so other programs get little.
Downloads are very large: about 95 to 156 GB for the GLM quants and 340 GB or more for DeepSeek.
To reach it from another device, use `--host 0.0.0.0` with `--api-key`. The README says always set a key.
The optional DFlash2 drafter is non-commercial only (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Maya-M-Derisked is an experimental edit that reduces refusals.
